`final class DrawGlMipmapBuilder`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IGlMipmapBuilder`](/reference/base-opengl/iglmipmapbuilder/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.opengl.render.texture` · **Module:** `base-opengl` · **Source:** [DrawGlMipmapBuilder.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/opengl/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/opengl/render/texture/DrawGlMipmapBuilder.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 2</span> <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

Builds the mipmaps of a texture by drawing a quad per level, for an OpenGL context that cannot blit framebuffers.

## Method details

<a id="DrawGlMipmapBuilder-method-build"></a>

### build

`void build(GlRenderBridge bridge, GlTexture texture, MipmapChain chain)` 

**Throws:**

- `IllegalStateException`: The shader that draws the mipmaps does not compile on …, update the graphics driver

Draws each level of the chain from the level above it, with a linear filter.
With the dev jar, prints once that the pixels may differ from the other backends; throws an `IllegalStateException` when its shader does not compile on the context.
